name: nest-migrations-example
description: Example project showing TypeORM migrations and seeders with sqlite

scripts.start: ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/index.ts || echo 'No server; example only'
scripts.migration:generate: npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register ./node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:generate src/migrations/CreateUsersTable -d src/data-source.ts
